title: Synocene, Beyond the Anthropocene: De-Anthropocentralising Human-Nature-AI Interaction

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the 27-item Ecocentric, Anthropocentric and Antipathetic Attitude Scale test to an LLM (ChatGPT) using a 7-point Likert scale, and qualitatively evaluating an image captioning model (BLIP) to observe whether generated text disproportionately centers humans in natural landscapes.
